[[Korvald's Chakram]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[focus item]] dropped by [[Korvald Willcrusher]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Sorrow's Furnace]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +12 (Requires 9 [[Domination Magic]])
:Domination Magic +1 (20% chance while using [[skill]]s)
:[[Health]] +30

== Replicas ==

Including visual appearance, a technical replica for this item is the [[Inscribed_Chakram_(metal)|Inscribed Chakram]] from collectors [[Kiishen]], [[Kristoffir Roi]], or crafter [[Sheco]].

=== Near replicas ===
; Without requiring the use of skills

It is possible to create a replica for this item that does not condition the improvement to domination magic on the use of skills with the following components:
* [[Inscribed Chakram]] from collector [[Jwup]]
* [[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Master of My Domain]]" inscription
OR
* [[Inscribed Chakram]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Derrick]], [[Hadusi]], [[Shausha]], [[Soros]], or [[Tehshan]]
* [[Perfect]] [[Focus Core]] [[of Fortitude]]
* Perfect "[[Inscription|Master of My Domain]]" inscription

; Lacking visual appearance and without mentioning that skill use is required.

It is possible to create a replica for this item that is visually different and does not condition the improvement to domination magic on the use of skills with the following components:
* One of the following [[Domination Magic]] [[focus item]]s:
** [[Destroyer Focus]] from crafter [[Balthor Coalforge]]
** [[Imperial Focus]] from collector [[Shen Xi]]
** [[Tormented Focus]] from collector [[Deacon of Whispers]]
* [[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Master of My Domain]]" inscription
OR
* One of the following [[Domination Magic]] [[focus item]]s:
**[[Asuran Focus]] from crafter [[Nojj]]
**[[Balthazar's Focus]] from collector [[Zaishen Mesmeric Weapon Master]]
**[[Deldrimor Focus]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]
**[[Focus of Purity]] from collector [[Iza Yoi]]
**[[Norn Focus]] from crafter [[Keti]]
**[[Oppressor's Focus]] from collector [[Lionguard (collector)|Lionguard]]
**[[Charr Focus]] from collector [[Tuomas]] (requires [[Bonus Mission Pack]])
**[[Mursaat Focus]] from collector [[Diane]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Tengu Focus]] from collector [[Akemi]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Undead Focus]] from collector [[Archivist of Whispers]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
* [[Perfect]] [[Focus Core]] [[of Fortitude]]
* Perfect "[[Inscription|Master of My Domain]]" inscription

== Unique counterpart ==
* [[Korrub's Vision]]
** These two items have differing descriptions: Korvald's states that it will boost Domination Magic by +1 with a ''"20% chance while using skills"'', while Korrub's reads "''20% chance''".
** However, both items work identically: the 20% chance is conditional on using Domination Magic and only affects the skill (e.g. it will not add +6 energy to a character with only rank 8 in Domination Magic).
